issues.title: Use game current time as default date in JSON-Editor for Force Elements in COAs
issues.body:
We do set the default date for date controls in retrieved JSON-editors.

But, when the date is within an array I looks like we aren't able to set the default date.

I _think_ we need to intercept the `add-row` function (or register a handler), like below.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/132664455-431f4dd4-77bd-4dd3-8dd4-08de29e2086e.png)
